options.name: endpoint
options.description: The endpoint to use (for instance V(ovh-eu)).

options.name: name
options.description: The IP address to manage (can be a single IP like V(1.1.1.1) or a block like V(1.1.1.1/28)).

options.name: service
options.description: The name of the OVH service this IP address should be routed.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The timeout in seconds used to wait for a task to be completed. Default is 120 seconds.

options.name: wait_completion
options.description: If V(true), the module waits for the IP address to be moved. If false, exit without waiting. The C(taskId) is returned in module output.

options.name: wait_task_completion
options.description: If not V(0), the module waits for this task ID to be completed. Use O(wait_task_completion) if you want to wait for completion of a previously executed task with O(wait_completion=false). You can execute this module repeatedly on a list of failover IPs using O(wait_completion=false) (see examples).
